title: Normal force calculation
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the normal force as N = mg cos θ + F sin θ, obtaining 40 N.

title: Kinetic friction force
description: Important: The student must correctly apply f = μN using the calculated normal force, obtaining 10 N.

title: Net force and acceleration
description: Essential: The student must apply Newton's second law along the incline (a = (F cos θ - mg sin θ - f)/m), obtaining 5 m/s².

title: Velocity at t=3s
description: Essential: The student must correctly use the kinematic equation v = v0 + at with the calculated acceleration, obtaining 15 m/s.

title: Force component resolution
description: Important: The student must correctly resolve the applied force F into components parallel and perpendicular to the incline.

title: Sign error in net force
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses an incorrect sign for friction or weight component in the net force equation.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Award credit for explicitly showing and checking units in calculations.

title: Incorrect normal force model
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses N = mg cos θ, ignoring the component of F perpendicular to the plane.
